Create index of names of ref and pfas reads from geo query
```{r}
library(GEOquery)
```
reference compound dataset is publicly available at the Gene Expression Omnibus under accession #GSE272576.

Explore this data 
datasets for PFOA, PFBS, PFOS, and PFDS = # GSE144775
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/r-language/how-to-show-code-but-hide-output-in-rmarkdown/ 
```{r, message = FALSE}
# this hides the messages of "GSM4296053 (595 of 609 entities)"

gse_pfas <- getGEO("GSE144775", GSEMatrix = FALSE)
gsm_list_pfas <- GSMList(gse_pfas)
```
```{r}
# gsm_pfas # tells all information
# gsm_list_pfas
```

In gsm_titles, pull out duration and concentration in the title into two columns append
```{r}
# make df of the names of samples GSM, then for that column, apply function to get the title in metadata
gsm_titles_pfas <- data.frame(
  GSM = names(gsm_list_pfas),
  title = sapply(gsm_list_pfas, function(x) Meta(x)$title),
  chemical = sub("^chemical: ","",sapply(gsm_list_pfas, function(x) Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[1])),
  duration = as.numeric(sub("^time point \\(days\\): ","",sapply(gsm_list_pfas, function(x) Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[3]))), # days
  # duration_full = sapply(gsm_list_pfas, function(x) Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[3]),
  dose = as.numeric(sub("^dose\\(um\\): ","",sapply(gsm_list_pfas, function(x) Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[2]))), # (um)
  replicate = "NA",
  tsv_title = "NA",
  # dose_full = sapply(gsm_list_pfas, function(x) Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[2]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Meta(gsm_list_pfas[["GSM4295460"]])$title
Meta(gsm_list_pfas[[5]])$characteristics_ch1
# Meta(gsm_list_pfas[[5]])$characteristics_ch1[1]
# sub("^chemical: ","",Meta(gsm_list_pfas[[5]])$characteristics_ch1[1])
Meta(gsm_list_pfas[[5]]) # as example for one sample

# if this not work wget, get parse!!

tail(gsm_titles_pfas)
```

Now we do the same for the reference compounds
reference compound dataset is publicly available at the Gene Expression Omnibus under accession #GSE272576.

```{r, message = FALSE}
# this hides the messages of "GSM4296053 (595 of 609 entities)"

gse_ref <- getGEO("GSE272576", GSEMatrix = FALSE)
gsm_list_ref <- GSMList(gse_ref)
```
```{r}
# gsm_ref # tells all information
# gsm_list_ref
```

In gsm_titles, pull out duration and concentration in the title into two columns append
```{r}
# make df of the names of samples GSM, then for that column, apply function to get the title in metadata
gsm_titles_ref <- data.frame(
  GSM = names(gsm_list_ref),
  title = sapply(gsm_list_ref, function(x) Meta(x)$title),
  chemical = sub("^chemical: ","",sapply(gsm_list_ref, function(x) Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[2])),
  duration = sapply(gsm_list_ref, function(x) {
  val <- sub("^timepoint: ", "", Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[4])
    if (val == "24h") {
      return(1)
    } else {
      return(as.numeric(sub("d$", "", val)))
    }
  }), # days
  # duration_full = sapply(gsm_list_ref, function(x) Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[3]),
  dose = as.numeric(sub("^dose: ","",sapply(gsm_list_ref, function(x) Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[3]))), # (um)
    replicate = (sub("^replicate: ","",sapply(gsm_list_ref, function(x) Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[5]))),
  # dose_full = sapply(gsm_list_ref, function(x) Meta(x)$characteristics_ch1[2]),
  tsv_title = sub(".*?(pool.*)", "\\1",sapply(gsm_list_ref, function(x) Meta(x)$title)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Meta(gsm_list_ref[["GSM4295460"]])$title
Meta(gsm_list_ref[[5]])$characteristics_ch1
# Meta(gsm_list_ref[[5]])$characteristics_ch1[1]
# sub("^chemical: ","",Meta(gsm_list_ref[[5]])$characteristics_ch1[1])
Meta(gsm_list_ref[[5]]) # just look at one sample for example

# if this not work wget, get parse!!

tail(gsm_titles_ref)
```

Create Ultimate index or Ultimate Metadata All

Import the premade index from metadata with SRR
```{r}
metadata_all_from_deseq_analysis <- read.csv("/home/lawrence/Documents/School/thesis/PFAS_project_R-analysis/data/data_input_deseq/metadata_all.csv",header=TRUE)

colnames(metadata_all_from_deseq_analysis)[colnames(metadata_all_from_deseq_analysis) == 'Sample.Name'] <- 'GSM'
```

```{r}
metadata_all_from_deseq_analysis
```
Create a master gsm_titles_all
```{r}
gsm_titles_all <- rbind(gsm_titles_pfas,gsm_titles_ref) # combine pfas and ref
```
Merge/Join the gsm_titles_all table by the GSM name with metadata_all_from_deseq_analysis
```{r}
ultimate_metadata_all <- merge(gsm_titles_all, metadata_all_from_deseq_analysis[,c("GSM","X")], by = "GSM", all.y = TRUE) # right join by the y or df2
```
```{r}
ultimate_metadata_all
```
Write file as csv for ultimate_metadata_all
```{r}
write.csv(ultimate_metadata_all, file = "/home/lawrence/Documents/School/thesis/PFAS_project_R-analysis/results_analysis/ultimate_metadata_all.csv")
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(ultimate_metadata_all$X))
sum(is.na(ultimate_metadata_all$title))
sum(is.na(ultimate_metadata_all$GSM))
colSums(is.na(ultimate_metadata_all)) # across all columns
```
